# Contributing

Thanks for your interest in Metrik. The full guide lives in
[docs/metrik-contributing.md](../docs/metrik-contributing.md). In short:

- Set up the tools with `mise install`, then make sure `mise run lint` and `mise run test` pass.
- Use [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org), one logical change per commit.
- Larger changes follow the spec-driven workflow described in the guide, with their specs under
  `specs/`.
- Report vulnerabilities privately, as described in the [security policy](SECURITY.md).
